senses.gloss: = נָטָה, to pitch a tent; put up a temporary structure.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 5b:12">Meg. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>נטיעה של שמחה נ׳</he> he put up a temporary structure for a festive religious occasion, v. <cite ref="A01676"><he>אַכְוַרְנְקָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 5b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>היכי נ׳ נטיעה וכ׳</he> how dared he put up a temporary structure on Purim?—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 111a:10">Snh. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>ביקש מקום לִנְטוֹעַ אהלו</he> (<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 6:4">Ex. R. s. 6</cite> <he>לִנְטוֹת</he>) he wanted a place to put up his tent; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to insert, to plant, contrad. to זרע.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:4">Kil. II, 4</cite> <he>זרועה ונמלך לנוֹטְעָהּ</he> if a field was sown, and he resolves to plant trees in it, <he>לא יאמר אֶטַּע וכ׳</he> he must not say, I will first plant and then &c., v. <cite ref="A02727"><he>אָפַךְ</he></cite>.
Ib. I, 8 אין נוֹטְעִין ירקות וכ׳ you must not plant vegetables &c.; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. נָטוּעַ; f. נְטוּעָה; pl. נְטוּעִום, נְטוּעִין; נְטוּעוֹת. Ib. V, 1; 4; sq.; a. fr.—Trnsf. to beget.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:1:6">Y. Yeb. I, 2ᵇ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="N00563"><he>נְטִיעָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 24b:7">B. Bath. 24ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 23b:14">Erub. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ רובו</he> if the larger portion of it was planted with trees, opp. <cite ref="G00722"><he>נזרע</he></cite>. Ohol. XVIII, 3 <he>אינה נִטַּעת כל נטע</he> must not be planted with any kind of trees; Tosef. ib. XVII, 10; a. fr.
